RESEARCH TOWARD FEWER THAN 208 STATES
29 October 2026 — prepared for Vladimir Reshetnikov

OUTCOME

an audited comparison and reproducible research contribution, not a new207
construction or a state-count lower bound. The retained208 machine is credited
to the incoming proposals, not presented as a new result.

The five submissions in the two user-specified commits contain nine literal
208-state tables but only TWO rooted transition-graph isomorphism classes.
All use the same conditional-history identification of the172/211 roles;
there is no independent deletion to stack across these submissions.

NEW RESEARCH
* Source-boundary projection supplies sound overapproximating seven-cell
  guards from complete arbitrary-natural symbolic primitive contracts,
  including compressed unary/list interiors and exact blank startup.
* A head-offset quotient lemma permits a different head position at merged
  control boundaries, including initialization by blank-tape translation.
* Whole closed-loop pruning preserves source control flow under checked zero
  guards, but fewer primitive occurrences worsen the existing shared-tree
  representation:3909->3904 leaves,197->200 distinct syntactic DAG nodes.
* Deeper-history, neutral-helper, offset, two-row, source-window and guarded
  layout searches are negative within their explicitly stated finite scopes.

RESULT AND LIMIT
================
This dossier does NOT establish a 207-state consistency machine. The requested
later commits already supply 208-state machines. The research here compares and
checks those constructions, extends the reduction search, and proves a new
obstruction to one tempting logical simplification. No rejected or unchecked
table is promoted to an accepted smaller machine.

Read paper/report.pdf; edit paper/report.tex and its three small included TeX
files. The report contains the mathematical arguments, exact comparison, search

NEW RESEARCH IN THIS DOSSIER
===========================
1. A two-element finite model shows that globally identifying the cover emitter's
   source and output roles collapses its intended arithmetic strength. PA proves
   consistency of the collapsed theory, so, if PA is consistent, it cannot retain
   the required PA-provable consistency biconditional with PA.
2. Exact exhaustion of all 279,936 independent parameter permutations in seven
   unrestricted axiom rows gives minimum source DAG size 197, with exactly four
   minimizers. Association and other source instructions are fixed. This is not
   a physical-state lower bound.
3. Both outgoing keeper rows were synthesized over all 21,528 unordered state
   pairs in each 208-state class, including the start-state pairs. Depth 12 and
   bound 71 runs gave no survivor; the same algorithm recovers the known U209
   fold as a positive control. A stronger source-conditioned Class A run also
   gives no survivor.
4. Correlated zero/positive and interval source invariants, all-spares-one
   specialized runtime contracts, row-order/association experiments, and
   shifted-head searches extend the discovery scope. Their exact bounds and
   evidence are in the report and research subdirectories.

U208: A THREE-CELL FOLD FOR THE CONSISTENCY OF PA
Prepared for Vladimir Reshetnikov, 29 October 2026

RESULT
======
machine/u208.tm is a complete deterministic binary, one-tape candidate with
208 working states (0 through 207) and a separate halt label 208. The tape is
two-way infinite, initially all zero; the start state and head coordinate are
zero. Every row moves L or R. Initialization is included in the 208 states.

The five supplied U209 code archives represent only TWO rooted transition
graph isomorphism classes. Four are the same machine up to state renaming;
Compatibility is the distinct alternative. report.pdf compares all of them,
proves the new deletion completely, explains its proof boundary, and prints
the complete dense U208 table. report.tex is the editable source.

NEW PATCH (JOINT NATIVE LABELS)
==============================
Delete state 211, redirect its incoming targets to 172, and change 172/read0
to write0, moveL, target217. The only changed retained rows are:

  163 0 0 L 211  ->  163 0 0 L 172
  163 1 1 R 211  ->  163 1 1 R 172
  172 0 0 L 67   ->  172 0 0 L 217

Plain uses different native labels: Joint helper217 is Plain helper214.
The final dense table and state map remove that naming ambiguity.

WHY IT WORKS
============
Complete incoming histories prove two facts in the parent:
* state211 scanning0 has predecessor1;
* state172 has predecessor word10.
Four child paths, lengths3,1,7,1, inspect only the current cell and at most
two left neighbors, and preserve the entire tape. All414 ordinary rows
commute with the projection211->172. Positive block simulation proves
halting equivalence from state0 on every common initial tape, with

  T208 = T209 + 2*N(parent211/read0) + 6*N(parent172/read0) <= 7*T209.

No source instruction, source address, numeric encoding, or theory changes.
The new machine equivalence is an ordinary mathematical proof formalizable
in PA. Composing it with the retained U209/calculus/U-to-PA calibration gives
the intended nonhalting iff Con(U) iff Con(PA) endpoint. This package contains
no new end-to-end Lean, Rocq, MM0, or exported PA proof object. It asserts no
unconditional nonhalting, consistency, global minimality, or certified record.
